info.title: SYN443 M2 enrollment pilot
info.description: Key-bound device enrollment, sessions, addressed configuration/overlay delivery and independently approved capability declarations. Owner account grants remain authoritative; no caller-supplied approval flag or URL is trusted.

One addressed device fetch lease. The response must not be cached or logged.

requestBody.description: 43-byte job ID, LF, 43-byte lease ID, LF and 1 to 10485760 provider bytes. The proof binds the complete frame.

204.description: Encrypted input accepted for source worker normalization or the exact result already accepted.

401.description: Invalid or replayed proof, or malformed frame.

403.description: Device session or job scope denied.

409.description: Lease expired, result changed or source revision superseded.

200.description: Addressed lease with optional validators for the active snapshot. No logging or caching.

204.description: No compatible pending job for this device.

requestBody.description: The original job and lease prefix, then NUL S443 0x02, a two-byte big-endian JSON length, metadata and optional provider bytes. Metadata is at most 4096 bytes. 200 and 304 allow etag, lastModified and quota; 304 has no body and requires the active snapshot. A provider error (401, 403, 404, 410, 429 or 5xx) sends only status. The proof binds the complete frame.

404.description: Endpoint disabled, wrong method or URL query.

post.description: Disabled unless owner overlayServiceId is configured and matches the signed service. No Origin/query. Fresh session-bound DPoP/nonce binds exact raw body. Current approved key-bound signed policy and account grant authorize namespace/reference/version/epoch. Same stable operation/body retries; another operation/body conflicts. Consume is idempotent and erases encrypted server envelope. No API signing private key. Registration/SDK proof remains a separate native acceptance gate.

oidcDPoP.description: Keycloak RS256 access JWT with pinned issuer, syn443-api audience, syn443-android azp and cnf.jkt.

deviceDPoP.description: Opaque ten-minute access token; refresh endpoint uses rotating key-bound refresh token.

code.description: Closed allowlist for the chosen kind; free-form details are rejected.

validators.description: Only version 2 leases may contain validators.

envelope.description: Independently verified addressed JWS. Never log or persist without per-grant protection.

x-syn443-storage: PostgreSQL transactions, explicit owner/API/publisher roles, encrypted receipt/reply/publication, hashed opaque tokens, durable nonce/replay/time fence. POST requestId reuse requires identical raw payload hash. No secrets in errors or logs.
